senses.gloss: ch. = b. h. צוּם (cmp. צמם) to restrain one’s self; to fast.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 12:16">Targ. II Sam. XII, 16</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:29">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 29</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <he>צָאֵים</he>, <cite ref="R00196"><he>צָיֵים</he></cite>; f. <he>צָיְימָא</he>, <he>צָיְמָא</he>; pl. <he>צָיְימִין</he>, <he>צָיְמִ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 12:23">Targ. II Sam. XII, 23</cite>. Targ. Y. II, Lev. l. c.; a. fr.—Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᶜ top <he>צָם תרי יומין</he> fasted two days (observed the Day of Atonement two days). Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ bot.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הוות צָיְימָה ומפרסמה</he> she used to fast and make it public; a. fr.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="R00195">same</cite>. Targ. Y. Lev. l. c.—Y. Ned. VIII, 40ᵈ bot. <he>צ׳ כל ערובת וכ׳ … ר׳</he> R. J. fasted every New Year’s eve; <cite ref="Yoma 2a">ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ … דצומין</he> observed three hundred voluntary fasts; Y. Meg. I, 70ᵈ top (also <cite ref="R00552"><he>צם</he></cite>). Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ <he>מְצַיְּימָה</he> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>אובדת וכ׳</he> she fasts and loses her virginity; a. fr.
